requests.required_shared_change: Freeze and implement one canonical plugin manifest/contribution/activation/quarantine contract and lifecycle through the Central Hub plugin host.
requests.reason: Standalone cylinders use incompatible draft/exact manifest shapes; isolated tests cannot prove host activation.
requests.expected_interface_contract: Versioned PDK manifest range, contribution descriptors, activation/disable/quarantine health, migration compatibility and public registration surface.
requests.cylinder_expectation_afterward: Each canonical plugin can be discovered and activated through public host contracts without private-core imports; incompatible plugins are blocked/quarantined truthfully.

requests.required_shared_change: Select/re-home one canonical ae.prediction_markets implementation and retire/supersede the duplicate legacy package through an explicit repository decision.
requests.reason: Two materially different Prediction Markets implementations share the same conceptual/stable identity; installing both would create ambiguous authority.
requests.expected_interface_contract: One canonical package identity and manifest wired to the frozen PDK, with compatibility/migration disposition for the superseded implementation.
requests.cylinder_expectation_afterward: Qualification detects exactly one production candidate for ae.prediction_markets and can activate it through the host.

requests.required_shared_change: Provide numbered core migration authority plus plugin-namespaced migration admission/ordering and upgrade-state reporting.
requests.reason: Current core still relies on development bootstrap/create_all and qualification cannot prove supported upgrade/recovery or safe plugin activation.
requests.expected_interface_contract: Versioned migration registry/runner with current schema identity, fresh-install/upgrade state, failure quarantine/recovery and namespaced plugin migration hooks.
requests.cylinder_expectation_afterward: Plugin migrations participate in the central lifecycle and qualification without direct ad-hoc schema mutation.
